{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and keep the highest sample_seq
# This is critical because some patients were re-tested
# The row with the highest sample_seq for each patient should be kept
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now check the value counts for 'site' to confirm how many sites there are
df['site'].value_counts()"}
